h2: Pool Equipment Canggu – Pumps, Filters & Chlorinators
intro: Canggu went from rice paddies to villa-dense streets almost overnight, and most pools were built alongside that rush. Pool Equipment Canggu work—pumps, sand or cartridge filters, salt chlorinators, lights and auto-fill—often needs attention within the first couple of seasons because of high groundwater, loose fittings and a constant leaf load. If your pump is noisy, filter pressure keeps climbing, or the multiport valve won't hold position, message us on WhatsApp with a short video and we'll sort it out.

sections.h3: Why Canggu's Groundwater and Fast Builds Stress Your Pool Gear
sections.text: Former paddies mean the water table sits high here, so pump rooms in Berawa and Pererenan see moisture creep along cable runs and corrode terminal blocks faster than in drier areas. Many villas went up quickly; hidden leaks behind tile, poorly sloped drains and loose pipe fittings tend to announce themselves in year two or three. A pump that once ran fine can start cavitation as surrounding soil shifts, and overflow channels never properly graded will back up into the pool after a hard rain.

sections.h3: The Call-Outs We See Most Around Echo Beach and Beyond
sections.text: A pump that won't prime after a power cut, a sand filter whose pressure keeps climbing despite backwashing, a multiport valve drifting off position overnight—these are the bread-and-butter jobs. Salt chlorinators lose efficiency when cell plates scale from hard groundwater, and underwater lights flicker or die once seals let in moisture. If your auto-fill float is stuck open you'll notice the waterline creeping past the skimmer every morning. Send a short clip of the symptom on WhatsApp and we'll tell you what part needs replacing before it takes out the rest.

sections.h3: What to Send on WhatsApp for an Accurate Quote
sections.text: No phone calls needed—just open WhatsApp and send us three things: a ten-second video of the issue (pump running, valve turning, light flickering), a photo of the equipment nameplate showing model and serial number, and a rough note on when the problem started. If the job involves filter media, mention whether it's sand or cartridge and roughly how long the current load has been in service. Pricing depends entirely on the specific job; once we see the photos and video we can give you a clear figure and schedule a visit around your villa manager's or tenant's availability.

sections.h3: Prevention Tips Before the Next Rainy Season Hits Canggu
sections.text: Streets and gardens flood here in heavy rain, so check pump-room drainage and make sure the overflow channel isn't blocked with leaf litter drifting in from surrounding fields. In Berawa and Pererenan especially, weekly skimming matters because guests drop sunscreen and leaves accumulate fast. Before October arrives, backwash the filter, inspect the multiport O-ring, test the chlorinator cell voltage, and confirm the auto-fill shuts off correctly. A twenty-minute walk-around now saves a flooded pump room and a week of cloudy water later.

faq.q: How often should I replace pool filter sand in Canggu?
faq.a: It depends on usage intensity and local water hardness; if thorough backwashing no longer brings pressure back down, the media is exhausted. Send a photo of your gauge reading on WhatsApp and we'll confirm whether a full replacement is due.

faq.q: Do you cover all neighbourhoods in Canggu for salt-chlorinator work?
faq.a: Yes—we handle cell cleaning, plate replacement and control-box faults across Berawa, Batu Bolong, Echo Beach, Pererenan, Babakan and Padonan. Just message us on WhatsApp with a short video showing the error code or symptom and we'll advise next steps.

faq.q: My pump room flooded after last week's rain—what do I check first?
faq.a: Switch off power at the breaker before touching anything wet, then look for standing water around the motor housing and any loose cable connections. Photograph the damage and send it over WhatsApp so we can tell you whether the pump needs drying out, rewiring or a full replacement.
